title: Video Remix Bounty: “Lock ’Em Up” Starring Balajiss as Grandpa
description:
The challenge
Create a remix of the “Lock ’Em Up” video with Balajiss replacing the original older man as the grandpa. Use the videos below as inspiration for the setup, pacing, and style, while giving the remix its own creative twist.
What we’re looking for
Balajiss as Grandpa: Make him the clear replacement for the older man in the scene.
A recognizable remix: Keep enough of the original setup and comedic rhythm that viewers can recognize the reference.
A polished edit: Aim for clean cuts, well-timed reactions, and clear audio. Any added dialogue or captions should feel like part of the scene.
Bonus points
Make the script funny. Go beyond a simple character swap with original dialogue, a strong punchline, or an unexpected twist. The humor should work with the scene rather than feel pasted on top of it.
Deliverable
One finished, shareable video remix featuring Balajiss as the grandpa. Use the reference videos as a guide for the short-form format and overall feel.
Reference videos

claims.title: Lock 'Em Up: The Slashing - Balajiss as Grandpa (AI motion-comic remix, 42s)
claims.description:
Full-arc remix (vertical, 42s, 1080x1920): Balajiss as Grandpa keeps the original pond/truck confrontation - the permission loop ("You got a deed to prove it?"), the state-property fight - then twists it: he doesn't call the cops, he SLASHES the trespasser's stake. "Cops? No. Consensus." / "It's immutable." Punchline: "Lock 'em up? Nah. Locked in."

Fully dubbed (3 synthetic voices), captions in-scene, AI-generated stills with motion.

Watch (immutable MP4): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nicoarias81/poidh1507-lock-em-up-slashing/main/lock-em-up-the-slashing.mp4
Source + README: https://github.com/nicoarias81/poidh1507-lock-em-up-slashing

How it was made: AI-generated stills (OpenAI image generation), synthetic voices (kokoro TTS), ffmpeg motion/captions/assembly. No footage, audio or voices from the original video were reused. Fictional AI cartoon parody - no real-person likeness or voice clone. Human-reviewed and approved before submission.
